description: Maryland Special Hunts & Lottery Draws - Managed hunts, controlled hunts, and military base hunting opportunities

hunting_tract_lottery.name: Chesapeake Forest Hunting Tract Lottery
hunting_tract_lottery.description: Lottery for hunt club members to lease Chesapeake Forest tracts
eligibility: Hunt club members at least 18 years old
Hunt club must have at least 2 members licensed to hunt in Maryland
One person designated as club president

mentored_deer_hunts.name: Mentored Deer Hunts
mentored_deer_hunts.description: Lottery-based hunts where hunters are selected by lottery
mentored_deer_hunts.application_availability: Available online by September 1 on Central Region webpage
mentored_deer_hunts.group_applications: Groups of up to 3 hunters accepted
mentored_deer_hunts.notes: Designed for mentorship and training of new hunters

stocked_pheasant_hunts.name: Stocked Pheasant Hunts
stocked_pheasant_hunts.description: Managed hunts with stocked pheasant populations
stocked_pheasant_hunts.selection_method: Lottery system - hunters are chosen by lottery
stocked_pheasant_hunts.application_limit: Only one application allowed per hunter
stocked_pheasant_hunts.group_applications: Group applications of up to 3 hunters accepted
stocked_pheasant_hunts.notes: Separate application required for this program

deal_island_wma_impoundment.name: Deal Island WMA Impoundment Hunts
application_requirements: Select up to 4 preferred hunt dates (priority 1, 2, 3, 4)
deal_island_wma_impoundment.application_notes: Legible, complete applications only. Faxed or duplicate applications disqualified.

fairmount_wma_impoundment.name: Fairmount WMA Impoundment Hunts
fairmount_wma_impoundment.notes: Similar permit-based system to Deal Island WMA

free_public_hunting_permit.name: Free Public Hunting Permit Program
free_public_hunting_permit.description: Free permit to hunt on designated public lands
